title: Washing your hands before eating
explanation: Washing your hands with soap before meals gets rid of germs you can't see and helps you stay healthy.

title: Recognizing fruits and vegetables
explanation: Learning to identify fruits and vegetables helps you choose healthy foods at the market or supermarket.

title: Measuring ingredients with a cup
explanation: Using a measuring cup helps you follow a recipe accurately, just like a real cook.

title: Helping set the table
explanation: Placing plates, cups and cutlery in the right spot helps your family and teaches you to keep things organized.

title: Folding clothes
explanation: Folding your clothes carefully keeps them tidy and is a great way to help around the house.

title: The water cycle
explanation: Water evaporates, forms clouds, and falls as rain. This cycle repeats endlessly and is essential for life on Earth.

title: Why we save water
explanation: Turning off the tap while you brush your teeth saves a lot of water. Clean water is precious and not endless.

title: Why you shouldn't play with electrical outlets
explanation: Electrical outlets carry electricity that can hurt you badly. Never put your fingers or objects into outlets — always ask an adult for help.

title: What a circuit breaker is
explanation: A circuit breaker is the switch that cuts a home's electricity in case of danger. You can only watch — never touch it on your own.

title: Preparing a simple sandwich with help
explanation: Making a sandwich is fun! An adult can help you cut the bread and ingredients safely.

title: Washing dishes with help
explanation: Washing dishes with an adult's help teaches you to be careful with glass plates and hot water.

title: Tidying your room
explanation: Putting your toys and books back in the right place makes your room nicer and easier to find things in.

title: Sorting trash for recycling
explanation: Sorting paper, plastic and glass into the right bins helps take care of the planet and gives materials a new life.

title: Knowing your country's emergency number
explanation: In many countries there's a special emergency number. Knowing it can help you ask for help in an emergency.

title: What to do if you smell gas
explanation: If you smell gas at home, leave the room and tell an adult right away. Never turn on lights or matches.

title: Never touching cleaning products alone
explanation: Cleaning products can be dangerous if touched or swallowed. Never handle them without an adult nearby.

title: Watering a plant
explanation: Plants need water to grow. Watering a plant every day is a lovely way to take care of nature.

title: Turning off the light when you leave a room
explanation: Turning off the light when you leave a room saves energy and helps the planet. It's a small thing you can do all by yourself.

title: Saving food instead of wasting it
explanation: Eating what's on your plate and not wasting food helps your family and the planet. You can ask for less and go back for more if you're still hungry.

title: Never touching the stove or oven alone
explanation: The stove and oven get very hot and can burn you. Look, learn, but only cook with an adult by your side.
